title: Measuring proximity to standard planes during fetal brain ultrasound scanning
abstract: arXiv:2404.07124v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents a pipeline designed to bring ultrasound (US) plane pose estimation closer to clinical use, demonstrating the feasibility of continuous, real-time proximity feedback for navigation to the standard planes (SPs) in the fetal brain. We propose a semi-supervised segmentation model that uses labeled SPs and unlabeled slices from 3D US volumes (non-SPs), achieving 0.93 mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on SPs and 0.86 mIoU on arbitrary non-SPs. The model incorporates a classification mechanism to identify and filter out frames lacking the fetal brain, and to generate masks for those containing it, enhancing the relevance of plane pose regression in clinical settings. Combined with 6D plane pose regression, our pipeline provides sensorless, continuous proximity detection to SPs with real-time distance metrics rather than binary plane recognition. translated_title: 胎儿脑部超声扫描过程中标准平面接近程度的测量
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个旨在使超声（US）平面姿态估计更接近临床应用的流程，证明了连续、实时的接近程度反馈用于胎儿脑部标准平面（SPs）导航的可行性。我们提出了一种半监督分割模型，该模型利用有标注的标准平面以及来自3D超声体积的无标注切片（非标准平面），在标准平面上实现了0.93的平均交并比（mIoU），在任意非标准平面上实现了0.86的mIoU。该模型融合了分类机制，可识别并过滤掉不含胎儿脑部的帧，并为含有胎儿脑部的帧生成掩码，从而增强了平面姿态回归在临床环境中的相关性。结合6D平面姿态回归，我们的流程提供了无需传感器的、连续的标准平面接近度检测，输出实时距离度量而非简单的二元平面识别。此外，我们通过部署验证了该方法的临床转化可行性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合半监督分割与6D平面姿态回归的超声流程，能够在胎儿脑部超声扫描中提供无需传感器、连续实时的标准平面距离反馈，推动超声平面姿态估计向临床应用迈进。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an ultrasound pipeline combining semi-supervised segmentation and 6D plane pose regression to provide sensorless, continuous, real-time proximity feedback for navigating to standard planes during fetal brain ultrasound scanning.
